channel.title: Erwin Mongui: case studies and writing
channel.description: Case studies and articles by Erwin Mongui on platform architecture, data, AI and engineering leadership.

item.title: Check before you believe: what a perfect speed score leaves out
item.description: A headless demo against two real Shopify stores, 24 runs under identical conditions: why demos are fast, why one test misleads, and tricks that work.

item.title: Best practices expire: keeping SEO, GEO and AEO current with AI
item.description: SEO, GEO and AEO practices expire. A simple system: a dated log, a monthly AI-assisted review with a reusable prompt, and a test before every change.

item.title: The threshold mattered more than the model: revisiting a bank marketing classifier
item.description: Revisiting our 2023 Kaggle bank marketing model: seven bugs, a rebuilt pipeline, and why tuning the F1 threshold beat every model change.

item.title: Kadabra: a Shazam for movies, and no way to know if it worked
item.description: Revisiting Kadabra, our 2023 Telegram bot that named movies from a photo or a plot: faces, age, vector search, and the evaluation it never had.

item.title: 51,000 ads, 190 rows: revisiting a Kijiji visit-prediction model
item.description: Revisiting our 2023 Kijiji car-ad visit model: a leaked model choice, 51,000 ads squeezed into 190 rows, and a rebuild that beats the baseline by 41%.

item.title: A lead distribution engine that connects to any CRM
item.description: How Erwin Mongui designed Fincaraiz's B2B lead distribution: GraphQL, fault-tolerant retries, 100% data parity and a Connector service for six CRM platforms.

item.title: A data platform from zero, as the first technical hire
item.description: As Cedar Planters' first technical hire, Erwin Mongui replaced third-party reporting tools with one data platform. New reports went from months to hours.

item.title: Finding delivery bottlenecks with lead time and cycle time
item.description: A five-step way to find where software work gets stuck using lead time, cycle time and flow metrics, confirm the cause with the team, and fix it.

item.title: How I measure engineering team health
item.description: The delivery, health and impact metrics I track, how they map to DORA and SPACE, and how to tell whether AI coding assistants are really helping a team.

item.title: Monolith to microservices, without stopping a 5M-visit platform
item.description: How Erwin Mongui moved Fincaraiz from ASP.NET to Django, React and Kubernetes for 5M+ monthly visits: zero downtime, 50% lower costs and NLP search.

item.title: From data analyst to data engineer, through one good question
item.description: How asking a data analyst to challenge our pipeline tool led to a better stack and a new data engineer. A guided discovery approach to mentoring, with AI.

item.title: Pick the tool your team can support, not the one on the shortlist
item.description: A single sign-on project took six times longer than planned. What went wrong, the tool-selection scorecard we use now, and how AI assistants change it.

item.title: Shaping the future: what new graduates need for a career in AI
item.description: An engineering manager's view of AI careers for new graduates: collaboration, real projects, AI-assisted development, evaluation, ethics and frameworks.

item.title: Taming the data jungle: JSON as the contract between your systems and AI
item.description: Why JSON became the contract between software and AI models: structured outputs with JSON Schema and Pydantic, tool calling, MCP, memory and model configs.

item.title: Replacing random RT-PCR checks with data-driven traveller selection
item.description: Our STEM Fellowship Big Data and AI Challenge 2023 paper: using WHO and Government of Canada data to prioritize travellers for RT-PCR checks, not at random.
